reason:
The declaration's opening paragraph is printed twice, back to back, as two byte-identical

blocks separated by a single space. A 290-character block repeated verbatim is a slip in the source page, not rhetorical repetition: the second copy adds no word the first does not have, and the sentence it repeats is the one that announces the response the rest of the document gives, which is said once or not at all. Left standing it is 22% of everything this edition stores, so a reader meets the same sentence twice and every measurement of the edition counts it twice.
